source: User-pasted browser result and attached application debug logs
sanitization: Retain only numeric timings/status and bounded request categories/outcomes; exclude hostnames, request IDs, URLs and raw attachment.
grouping: Upstream records grouped by following outer request completion; first PUT is untimed fixture creation and excluded. Ten subsequent PUTs matched in sequence to browser samples.
limitations: Sequential idle-window attribution, no request-level correlation or independent build identity. OAuth time may be included; body timing includes consumer time. No inference about January 3 failure cause.
cleanup: User result reports cleanupVerified=true; January 3 untouched
